description: This Python script defines a class MISPItemToRedis for interacting with Redis to store MISP items, attributes, objects, and sightings, providing methods to push various MISP-related data into Redis lists.

classes.name: MISPItemToRedis
classes.description: A class for normalizing and adding MISP items, attributes, objects, and sightings to Redis for later processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and sets the keyname and connection parameters.

methods.name: push_json
methods.description: Pushes JSON data to a Redis list with a specified action suffix.

methods.name: push_attribute
methods.description: Pushes a formatted attribute to Redis.

methods.name: push_attribute_obj
methods.description: Pushes an attribute object to Redis.

methods.name: push_object
methods.description: Pushes a generic object with a 'name' field to Redis.

methods.name: push_sighting
methods.description: Pushes a sighting record to Redis.

methods.name: push_sighting_obj
methods.description: Pushes a sighting object to Redis.
